candidate.source_evidence_span: Major minerals in potato tubers include nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), calcium (Ca), magnesium (Mg), sulfur (S), and minor and trace minerals include sodium (Na), zinc (Zn), iron (Fe), copper (Cu), manganese (Mn), boron (B), iodine (I), silicon (Si), and bromine (Br) ( Navarre et al., 2009; Beals, 2019).
